results.overview: Located in the center of a remote island, the Abyss is the last unexplored region, a huge and treacherous fathomless hole inhabited by strange creatures where only the bravest adventurers descend in search of ancient relics. In the upper levels of the Abyss, Riko, a girl who dreams of becoming an explorer, stumbles upon a mysterious little boy.
results.name: Made in Abyss

results.original_name: マルルクちゃんの日常
results.overview: A series of 4 shorts accompanying the release of "Made in Abyss: Dawn of the Deep Soul" in theaters, the shorts depict Marulk's everyday life.
results.name: Marulk's Daily Life
